    Hotel Shantam Regency is a 3-star hotel and event venue located on Swami Vivekanand Road, Adampur, Bhagalpur, Bihar. 
    Key Details & Amenities
    • Address: Swami Vivekanand Path, Rani Chandra Koti, Adampur, Bhagalpur, Bihar 812001 (about 2.3 km from Bhagalpur Junction Railway Station) 
    • Contact: +91 93342 71294 
    • Check-in / Check-out: Check-in at 12:00 PM; Check-out at 11:00 AM or 12:00 PM (depending on the booking platform) 
    • Rooms & Types: Features air-conditioned rooms including Deluxe, Executive, and Premium/Suite options
       
    • On-Site Amenities:
      • On-site restaurant and 24-hour room service
      • Free Wi-Fi and free self-parking
      • Banquet halls and event/wedding spaces 
    • Important Policies: Valid government-issued ID is required at check-in; unmarried couples and pets are generally not allowed. 
    You can check live room availability or book a stay through platforms like MakeMyTrip or Agoda. 
    Are you looking to book a room, inquire about banquet/wedding booking, or check room pricing for specific dates?
